name: Mr. Nice
aliases: Mr. Nice G13 x Hash Plant
summary: **Mr. Nice** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] released in 1999 by [[breeder:Sensi Seeds]], crossing [[g13|G13]] and [[hash-plant|Hash Plant]]. It is named for Howard Marks, a smuggler-turned-author who used the same nickname.
